label: thm-foundation-excludes-membership-cycles-retry2
tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN
BOUNDARY: Checked empty set: no cycle condition can involve it, so theorems hold vacuously and proof never depends on non-emptiness of members. Checked cases where some of x,y,z coincide (x=y, y=z, x=z, all equal): the constructed S still has members among {x,y,z} and the case analysis still yields a contradiction because the required membership relations are given by the cycle. Checked that S is never empty: {x} has x, {x,y} has x and y, {x,y}∪{z} has at least one of them. Checked binary union membership: z ∈ {x,y} ∪ {z} iff z ∈ {x,y} or z ∈ {z}, which correctly gives exactly x,y,z, so no extraneous elements.
CHECKED: Read every numbered step (1.1, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1) and every cited fact (def-axiom-of-foundation, def-unordered-pair-and-singleton, def-union-of-a-set-and-binary-union, lem-unions-and-intersections-of-small-families). All citations are faithful and each step is mathematically licensed by the cited facts.
